title: Variable Inspector - public implementations survey
definition: Examines program variables during debugging.
description:
Variable Inspector is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Examines program variables during debugging. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Variable Inspector. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Variable Inspector. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Variable Inspector capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

t: Variable Inspector review checklist - practitioner discipline
title: Variable Inspector review checklist - practitioner discipline
definition: The review checklist discipline for Variable Inspector: examines program variables during debugging..
description:
review checklist is the Variable Inspector discipline: Examines program variables during debugging. It turns Variable Inspector from an event into a repeatable capability.

In practice this means: keep a failure log: what broke, why, and what now prevents it; review the result with fresh eyes before calling it done; declare inputs, expected outputs, and acceptance checks before starting Teams that follow the discipline get predictable builds; teams that skip it get interesting stories. The Signature line prefers predictable builds, and this record's demo makes the discipline concrete and runnable.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Variable Inspecto
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Variable Inspecto
definition: Ladder drill (foundation): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Variable Inspector from a one-paragraph brief.
description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Variable Inspector from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Variable Inspector needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
